cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: The Plan Gets Better
cards.instruction: Celebrate every setback as proof that the scheme is becoming more sophisticated, selective, or impossible to detect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You folded the map, so I folded it again. Our secret proposal spot has disappeared. Even harder to find—excellent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I folded back the car park. You've hidden the park entrance. I'm carrying your table; tell me where we're going.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Unfold the road, then. We'll look like movers; better camouflage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your girlfriend's coming down the road. She's offering to carry the chairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Ask her to bring them; nobody suspects a proposal they're helping move.

reason: Mistaken copied map fold creates navigation failure; B practical help and girlfriend solution become increasingly convincing cover, not arbitrary obstruction.
